# PRONOSTIA comparison tables (revision R1; generated by Experiments/r1_tables.py)

Primary endpoint: bearing-averaged CES MAE. Δ = (comparator − reference) / comparator; positive: reference better. p: exact two-sided sign-flip test over bearings; Holm: adjusted over the seven baselines (plan Section 8). Pooled columns: window-pooled metrics, mean ± SD over 20 seeds. PAVA: offline reference.
